verdict.rationale: EBANX documents local-currency acceptance as part of its recurring payments solution, and real-time tracking of balances, scheduled payouts and settlement history, which covers the charging side and some settlement visibility. Nothing in the pack shows cross-border settlement to the merchant's bank in their home currency or how FX conversion rates and fees are shown. Missing for 10: documented settlement in the merchant's home currency, explicit FX rate and fee transparency, local-currency charging beyond the recurring-payments claim, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Recurring Payments solution that includes local currency and alternative payment method acceptance, unified reconciliation
Track your available balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history in real time with full financial visibility.
